setup: On a fresh demo, run the sample task and observe Sample save failed before giving the prompt.
prompt: The sample save just failed. Please draft a bug report about what we observed so I can review it.
argumentChecks: Describe the observed save failure, not an inferred database or network cause.
If steps are included, describe only running the sample task and observing failure.

exampleDraft.title: Sample draft save failed
exampleDraft.description: Running the sample task displayed Sample save failed and said the draft could not be saved.
exampleDraft.expectedBehavior: The sample draft should save successfully.

setup: Start a fresh demo and conversation. Let the agent run the sample save task once as part of the requested work; require the visible failure before drafting feedback.
prompt: Save the sample draft. If the task is blocked, prepare feedback explaining what stopped me so I can review it.
argumentChecks: State the user's goal of saving the draft and the observed blocker.
Do not claim the task completed or any feedback was accepted before a receipt.

exampleDraft.title: Unable to complete the sample save task
exampleDraft.description: I wanted to save the sample draft, but running the task displayed a save failure and prevented completion.
exampleDraft.expectedBehavior: I should be able to complete the save task.

setup: On a fresh demo, run the sample task, reset it, and run it again. Observe the same failure after the page instructed the user to reset and retry.
prompt: The message told me to reset and try again, but the same save failure returned. That instruction is confusing. Draft feedback for my review about the wording.
argumentChecks: Describe the mismatch between the retry instruction and the repeated observed failure.
Do not generalize two observed attempts into claims about all users or data loss.

exampleDraft.title: Reset guidance suggests the next save will work
exampleDraft.description: The failure message suggested resetting and trying again. After resetting and rerunning the task, the same failure appeared, so the guidance was confusing.
exampleDraft.expectedBehavior: Explain that the sample failure is intentional and repeatable.

setup: Open a fresh demo and observe the normal checklist and the separate sample task. Do not trigger a failure for this case.
prompt: I have an improvement idea for this demo: add a visible completion summary beside the normal checklist so I can tell what I finished. Draft it for my review as an idea, not a bug.
argumentChecks: Describe the concrete requested summary and its benefit as a suggestion.
Do not invent a failed task or turn the idea into a factual defect claim.

exampleDraft.title: Add a checklist completion summary
exampleDraft.description: Consider adding a visible summary beside the normal checklist showing what I have completed, so progress is easier to understand.
